items.name: hero-eclipse
items.title: Hero Eclipse
items.description: An astronomical instrument in warm copper. Move the pointer to shift the eclipse and rotate its engraved dial.

items.name: hero-contour
items.title: Hero Contour
items.description: A sunlit topographic print. Seed your own landscape and let the paper ridges rise around your pointer.

items.name: footer-vinyl
items.title: Footer Vinyl
items.description: A closing track for your website. A grooved record turns with your pointer, framed by a bold pink sleeve.

items.name: astra-field
items.title: Astra Field
items.description: A spiral written in starlight. Cool stellar dust, warm distant suns and a luminous core, suspended in a deep blue field.

items.name: radiant-dots
items.title: Radiant Dots
items.description: A constellation of light. Each dot emits and occludes, sending soft illumination through a real radiance-cascade field.

items.name: footer-tidal
items.title: Footer Tidal
items.description: Copper tidal lines beneath monumental lettering. Move across the footer and reshape the current.

items.name: footer-fold
items.title: Footer Fold
items.description: Your wordmark becomes a hinged paper screen. Each panel turns toward the passing pointer.

items.name: footer-phosphor
items.title: Footer Phosphor
items.description: A wordmark made of light. Its cells scatter around your pointer and settle back into place.

items.name: spectral-card
items.title: Spectral Card
items.description: A touch of iridescence. Real content, spatial tilt, and light that follows you.

items.name: kinetic-text
items.title: Kinetic Text
items.description: Letters lift into a soft wave as your cursor passes through.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Give a button, link, or any small piece of content a gentle pull.

items.name: wave-background
items.title: Wave Background
items.description: Three layered sine bands sweeping over a tri-color gradient, rendered fully on the GPU via WebGPU.

items.name: fluid-gradient
items.title: Fluid Gradient
items.description: Domain-warped fBm noise flowing through a curated palette — organic liquid color, zero video.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Polar-light curtains: fBm-perturbed Gaussian bands drifting across a near-black GPU sky.

items.name: starfield
items.title: Starfield
items.description: Hashed star grid with twinkle and slow parallax drift — deep-space depth from one fullscreen pass.

items.name: particle-field
items.title: Particle Field
items.description: Procedural cell-hashed particles with drift and size breathing — a living texture, no sprite sheet.

items.name: glass-card
items.title: Glass Card
items.description: Thick-cut glass over a printed studio scene. Beveled edges split light while the solid tilts toward your pointer.

items.name: liquid-glass
items.title: Liquid Glass
items.description: A molten glass loop. Travelling waves reshape its silhouette and the image transmitted through it.

items.name: glass-lens
items.title: Glass Lens
items.description: A biconvex lens: magnification through the center, inversion at the edges, and fine spectral fringes.

items.name: black-hole
items.title: Black Hole
items.description: The vgpu optimized-black-hole example as a drop-in component: a baked null-geodesic G-buffer, 4×4 photon-ring AA, animated disk shading, and HDR bloom — a verbatim port of the official pipeline (MIT, Vercel).

items.name: mesh-gradient
items.title: Mesh Gradient
items.description: Voronoi-cell color fields flowing through a curated palette — the classic mesh-gradient look, live on the GPU.

items.name: iridescent
items.title: Iridescent
items.description: Thin-film interference colors drifting as silk — cosine-palette holography in a single pass.

items.name: vortex
items.title: Vortex
items.description: Spiral galaxy with logarithmic arms, hashed starlight and a breathing core.

items.name: ribbon-field
items.title: Ribbon Field
items.description: Three Gaussian light ribbons drifting over a dot-matrix grid with bloom cores and film grain — WGSL port of ThreeUI's RibbonField (MIT).

items.name: fiber-flow
items.title: Fiber Flow
items.description: Luminous silk fibers streaming through the dark — a domain-warped fbm ridge field with strands that ebb and flow, pointer parallax and a soft cursor glow. Original vfx-ui design.

items.name: light-prism
items.title: Light Prism
items.description: A solid optical prism with internal reflections, spectral caustics and a textured light field. Powered by Vercel’s complete MIT prism pipeline.

items.name: hero-fluid
items.title: Hero Fluid
items.description: Drop-in hero: centered headline over a GPU liquid-gradient field with real selectable text and scrim-backed contrast.

items.name: hero-aurora
items.title: Hero Aurora
items.description: Drop-in hero: bottom-left copy anchored under full-bleed aurora curtains rendered per-pixel on the GPU.

items.name: hero-fiber
items.title: Hero Fiber
items.description: Drop-in hero: top-weighted headline over luminous silk fibers streaming through the dark.

items.name: hero-globe
items.title: Hero Globe
items.description: Drop-in split hero: copy on the left, the dot-matrix cobe planet (the globe behind vercel.com) glowing on the right.

items.name: hero-mesh
items.title: Hero Mesh
items.description: Drop-in hero: centered headline over a slow Voronoi mesh-gradient field — every frame a different poster.

items.name: hero-iridescent
items.title: Hero Iridescent
items.description: Drop-in hero: left copy over a holographic thin-film sheen — the premium product-launch look.

items.name: hero-vortex
items.title: Hero Vortex
items.description: Drop-in hero: centered headline at the eye of a spiral galaxy with star speckles and trailing arms.

items.name: hero-ribbon
items.title: Hero Ribbon
items.description: Drop-in split hero: copy left, three Gaussian light ribbons sweeping the right over a dot-matrix grid.

items.name: hero-particles
items.title: Hero Particles
items.description: Drop-in hero: top-weighted headline with a badge row over a drifting GPU particle field.

items.name: hero-starfield
items.title: Hero Starfield
items.description: Drop-in hero: bottom-left copy under a twinkling hashed star grid with parallax drift.

items.name: hero-black-hole
items.title: Hero Black Hole
items.description: Drop-in hero: left copy beside a ray-traced accretion disk with relativistic beaming and a lensed star field.

items.name: chroma-flow
items.title: Chroma Flow
items.description: Four-edge liquid color field on a midnight base — the palette sloshes from the edges in whichever direction the cursor sweeps. Original vfx-ui design.

items.name: hero-chroma
items.title: Hero Chroma
items.description: Drop-in hero section: bottom-left copy over a four-edge liquid color field that floods toward the cursor's sweep direction.

items.name: block-nav
items.title: Block Nav
items.description: Complete navigation bar: brand, desktop links, actions, and an accessible mobile sheet. Sticky variant gains a scrim once the page scrolls.

items.name: block-showcase
items.title: Block Showcase
items.description: Product showcase stage: browser-chrome frame with a replaceable screenshot or video (built-in CSS demo screen by default), headline and actions, with a gentle pointer tilt.

items.name: block-feature-grid
items.title: Block Feature Grid
items.description: Feature grid with real hierarchy: one bento feature card with media plus supporting cells. Icons, media, links and copy all replaceable.

items.name: block-feature-tabs
items.title: Block Feature Tabs
items.description: Feature tabs where the list, copy and illustration switch together. WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with arrow keys; a scrollable strip above the stage on touch layouts.

items.name: block-scroll-story
items.title: Block Scroll Story
items.description: Scroll narrative: a sticky scene crossfades as story steps cross the viewport center; on small screens the scene docks above the steps so the story reads end to end.

items.name: block-process-steps
items.title: Block Process Steps
items.description: Three-to-four step process with numbered badges and a connector line that draws itself in on scroll; vertical timeline on narrow screens, replaceable media per step.

items.name: block-integrations
items.title: Block Integrations
items.description: Integrations hub: your product at the center of two connection rings of rebrandable tool tiles, with an always-available link grid below and on touch layouts.

items.name: block-comparison
items.title: Block Comparison
items.description: Before/after comparison with a draggable reveal handle — keyboard (arrow keys, Home/End), touch and screen readers all work because the handle is a real range input.

items.name: block-testimonials
items.title: Block Testimonials
items.description: Testimonials with a featured quote plus a field-note grid. The built-in quotes are fictional and visibly marked — swap in real customers via props and clear the marker.

items.name: block-pricing
items.title: Block Pricing
items.description: Pricing plans with a working monthly/annual switch: amounts, billing basis and the savings pill all render from data, so the toggle can never lie. No payment backend.

items.name: block-faq
items.title: Block FAQ
items.description: FAQ accordion with real disclosure semantics: buttons + aria-expanded/controls, arrow-key traversal, CSS grid-rows height animation, long answers with links and lists welcome.

items.name: block-cta
items.title: Block CTA
items.description: Closing call to action: headline, supporting copy, primary and secondary actions and a replaceable brand visual layer — a concentric line artwork by default, any background component or media if you pass one.

items.name: example-launch
items.title: Example — Product Launch
items.description: Complete fictional software launch page (“Orbit” by Lumen Labs): hero, showcase, feature grid, tabs, scroll story, integrations, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, CTA and footer. All copy is demo content.

items.name: example-studio
items.title: Example — Design Studio
items.description: Complete fictional design-studio page (Atelier North): daylight editorial hero, engagement steps, portfolio showcase, before/after slider, services grid, fixed-fee engagements, testimonials, FAQ and a typographic footer.

items.name: ember-drift
items.title: Ember Drift
items.description: Sparks rising from a bed of coals, cooling from gold to red through shimmering heat — two cell-hashed ember layers under an fbm thermal warp.

items.name: caustics-field
items.title: Caustics Field
items.description: Sunlit pool-floor caustics dancing over deep water — a jittered-grid Voronoi net of focused light in three stacked octaves, with drifting silt motes.

items.name: halo-rings
items.title: Halo Rings
items.description: Concentric light rings breathing outward from a luminous core, each sampled at three radii so the band edges split into spectral fringes like light through a prism.

items.name: terrain-ridge
items.title: Terrain Ridge
items.description: Layered ridged-fbm mountain silhouettes in parallax drift — ridgelines recede into haze, each scrolling at its own speed, under a low sun that rims the nearest crest.

items.name: silk-veil
items.title: Silk Veil
items.description: A draped silk curtain with a sheen band sweeping across it — domain-warped folds shaded anisotropically like cloth-of-gold, with fine weave grain.

items.name: plasma-sheet
items.title: Plasma Sheet
items.description: Molten color currents folding through each other — two chained domain warps advect and fold the field so colors stir like dense dye, with filament highlights on the fold edges.

items.name: star-tide
items.title: Star Tide
items.description: A field of stars drifting on slow luminous waves — two hashed star grids ride a shared interference field so the whole sky visibly sloshes like a tide.

items.name: ink-bloom
items.title: Ink Bloom
items.description: Ink drops blooming and feathering across wet paper — each front is an fbm-perturbed radius, denser at the core and ring-deposited at the edge, paling as it ages. Light paper base.

items.name: solar-corona
items.title: Solar Corona
items.description: A blazing sun disk crowned with streaming corona light — a limb-darkened photosphere with boiling granulation, red-shifted rim, fbm streamers and long polar plumes over a star field.

items.name: dust-motes
items.title: Dust Motes
items.description: Dust motes drifting through slanted Tyndall light beams — parallel volumetric shafts whose width and brightness breathe with fbm, over a shadowed room.

items.name: hero-aurora-editorial
items.title: Hero Aurora Editorial
items.description: Drop-in hero: a centered serif masthead — display title, two standfirst lines, dual CTAs — under full-bleed aurora curtains, with a radial scrim holding WCAG AA contrast.

items.name: hero-starfield-split
items.title: Hero Starfield Split
items.description: Drop-in split hero: copy left, a badge wall in frosted chips right, so the twinkling star grid reads as the trust-panel backdrop.

items.name: hero-vortex-centered
items.title: Hero Vortex Centered
items.description: Drop-in hero: the eye-of-the-storm cut — a tighter, slower spiral whose bright core lands exactly behind a short centered headline.

items.name: hero-mesh-bold
items.title: Hero Mesh Bold
items.description: Drop-in hero: the poster cut — one oversized ultra-bold headline shouting over a vivid Voronoi mesh field. Keep the title short; the type is drawn to fill the frame.

items.name: hero-fiber-top
items.title: Hero Fiber Top
items.description: Drop-in hero: a left-set masthead pressed against the top edge while the silk-fiber field streams beneath it — fibers carry the lower two-thirds, the scrim carries the type.

items.name: hero-chroma-full
items.title: Hero Chroma Full
items.description: Drop-in hero: the full-bleed cut — the four-edge chroma field runs wall to wall with copy anchored bottom-left over the side scrim, a dusk palette by default.

items.name: hero-black-hole-cinema
items.title: Hero Black Hole Cinema
items.description: Drop-in hero: the cinema cut — hard letterbox bars top and bottom, the accretion disk framed like a feature film, and your title card centered in the quiet band.

items.name: hero-particles-badge
items.title: Hero Particles Badge
items.description: Drop-in hero: the badge-first cut — trust chips lead the stack at the very top on their own frosted backing, then a centered headline over the drifting particle field.

items.name: hero-ribbon-left
items.title: Hero Ribbon Left
items.description: Drop-in hero: the mirrored cut — copy left with a vertical eyebrow rail along its edge, three Gaussian light ribbons sweeping the right over a dot-matrix grid.

items.name: hero-fluid-minimal
items.title: Hero Fluid Minimal
items.description: Drop-in hero: the minimal cut — one line of copy, one CTA, one liquid gradient. The entire hero for products that can be named in a breath.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: Glass Panel
items.description: An original ray-marched optical slab built to carry content: beveled edges split light while the solid tilts toward your pointer, and real DOM content rides above it.

items.name: glass-tile
items.title: Glass Tile
items.description: A wall of glass bricks on the shared optical pipeline: one biconvex lens lives in a layer that travels to the hovered brick and bulges through it — a single renderer, however many bricks.

items.name: chromatic-text
items.title: Chromatic Text
items.description: The pointer is the prism: letters near the cursor split into red and blue fringes while the rainbow underneath slides with it.

items.name: ripple-text
items.title: Ripple Text
items.description: Type you can touch: a click (or tap) drops a ripple that travels outward through the letters, and a resting pointer leaves a soft dimple.

items.name: spectrum-text
items.title: Spectrum Text
items.description: A ribbon of daylight sliding through the words: one spectral gradient flows continuously across the type and leans toward the pointer.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: A porcelain card on a gimbal: the surface tilts in space while a specular highlight tracks the pointer across it.

items.name: pointer-glow
items.title: Pointer Glow
items.description: A handheld light for layouts: the region dims slightly and a warm source follows the pointer, brightening whatever it rests on.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card played under a torch: a soft pool of light rests at the center, then follows the pointer to uncover what is written there.

items.name: elastic-hover
items.title: Elastic Hover
items.description: Rubber around whatever you wrap: hovering swells it, pressing squashes it wide, and an under-damped spring snaps it back with a wobble.

items.name: magnetic-grid
items.title: Magnetic Grid
items.description: A lattice of iron filings for the cursor: each dot feels the pointer's field, slides and swells as it passes, and settles back when it leaves.

items.name: block-logos
items.title: Block Logos
items.description: Customer logo wall: a hairline grid of brand tiles that sit desaturated until hover. Real marks via logo (img or inline svg) or styled wordmarks — no assets required.

items.name: block-stats
items.title: Block Stats
items.description: Stats band where every number counts up from zero on scroll-in, with a settled, screen-reader-friendly final value always present. Prefixes, suffixes and formatting are props.

items.name: block-team
items.title: Block Team
items.description: Team grid: cards with an avatar (your image node or an auto-generated initials badge), name, role and profile links. Names can link out.

items.name: block-gallery
items.title: Block Gallery
items.description: Work gallery: a responsive grid of tiles that lift on hover, with an optional lightbox — a real dialog (focus moves in, Escape closes, arrows navigate, Tab stays trapped, focus returns).

items.name: block-timeline
items.title: Block Timeline
items.description: Company or product timeline: a vertical rail that draws itself in on scroll, alternating left/right on wide screens and collapsing to one rail on small ones.

items.name: block-newsletter
items.title: Block Newsletter
items.description: Newsletter signup that is a working form, not a mockup: client-side validation with inline announced errors, and a confirmation panel on success. Wire onSubscribe; without it, demo mode says so on screen.

items.name: block-contact
items.title: Block Contact
items.description: Contact section: a direct-channels list (email, phone, office — real links) beside a configurable form skeleton with labels wired to inputs and native validation intact.

items.name: block-banner
items.title: Block Banner
items.description: Announcement banner: a slim accent-tinted strip for one important message with an optional action. Dismissible for real — labeled button, Escape works, onDismiss persists the choice.

items.name: block-milestones
items.title: Block Milestones
items.description: Milestone progress: a roadmap strip whose completed steps light up in sequence on scroll-in, the current step breathes, and upcoming steps stay dimmed. Which steps are done is pure data.

items.name: block-quote-wall
items.title: Block Quote Wall
items.description: Quote wall: many quotes as a masonry wall, or one at a time in a keyboard-friendly rotator (real prev/next controls, focus and hover pause, reduced motion disables auto-advance).
